Tess (People Ops): Thanks for joining the All1Hands — opening this thread for any remaining hybrid/office ops + offsite follow-ups. I'll capture answers and post the one-pager later. :memo:

Ravi (Eng): If my team wants a 1-week sprint offsite in Denver, what's the approval timeline?

Tess (People Ops): Ideal: 68 weeks for venue + travel. Submit Offsite Request with headcount, rough agenda, accessibility needs. Exec ok needed if > $12k total.

Nora (Office Ops): Props for accessibility checklist requests. We require venues to confirm step-free access and captioning options for remote attendees. I can share a template.

Ravi (Eng): Can we reimburse short-term coworking passes while visiting another city?

Ethan (HR): Yes — coworking passes expensable under travel with receipts and manager note. If longer than 3 weeks, treat as temporary location update.

Tess (People Ops): Travel approvals: manager ok for typical trips. Anything > $2k or with special billing routes requires Finance review. Use the TravelForm so routing is automatic.

Ravi (Eng): What about tax/visa for working remotely from another country for 10 days?

Ethan (HR): Under 14 days is usually fine but check country rules. If you're unsure, ping HR with dates and country before booking.

notices-bot: Reminder: Book desks in hub calendar 48+ hours before arrival to ensure seating.

Tess (People Ops): Action items: 1) post offsite checklist + Offsite Request link tomorrow, 2) Nora to share venue/access template, 3) short FAQ on remote-country stays. Thanks! :tada:
